annotations.text:
CURRENT (reference)
What you have today: dark, airy, glowing circles. Kept here to compare against.

A — EDITORIAL LIGHT
Warm paper, serif type, hairline rules; actions as an elegant side column.
Tradeoff: light UI around video makes footage judgment harder than a dark room.

B — PRO NLE
Dense editor language: waveform strip, IN/OUT timecodes, codec chips, compact rect buttons. Most informative.
Tradeoff: busiest; loses the minimal charm.

C — BRUTALIST POSTER
Hard borders, offset shadows, huge type, one loud red. Unmistakable, fun to share.
Tradeoff: loud personality — polarizing for a daily tool.

D — TACTILE DECK
Camera-body hardware feel: embossed rounded keys, groove timeline, orange LED accents. Closest evolution of your current look.
Tradeoff: soft shadows need care to avoid mushiness at small sizes.

E — PHOSPHOR TERMINAL
CRT green, monospace, ASCII timeline, keyboard-first labels. Niche and memorable.
Tradeoff: pure novelty aesthetic; timecode readability relies on mono discipline.
